title: Robotics startup Generalist reaches $3B valuation, sources say
summary: Robotics startup Generalist has reached a $3 billion valuation following a $200 million funding extension, demonstrating strong investor confidence in physical AI technology just months after achieving a $2 billion valuation. The milestone highlights accelerating funding momentum in the robotics sector.
content: The $200 million extension comes just months after the physical AI startup reached a $2 billion valuation.

zh.title: 机器人初创公司Generalist估值达30亿美元，知情人士称
zh.summary: 机器人初创公司Generalist在获得2亿美元融资扩展后，估值达到30亿美元，这表明投资者对物理AI技术充满信心，距该公司实现20亿美元估值仅几个月。这一里程碑凸显了机器人行业融资动力的加速。

title: OpenAI loses a top data center exec, as stream of high-profile departures continues
summary: OpenAI has lost a top data center executive as part of ongoing high-profile departures from the company. The departure follows an organizational reshuffle of OpenAI's infrastructure division under new leadership.
content: Before Malone left, OpenAI had already reshuffled its infrastructure org, shifting his reporting line away from President Greg Brockman and putting Vice President Sachin Katti in charge of the group.

zh.title: OpenAI失去数据中心高管，高层离职潮继续
zh.summary: OpenAI在继续出现高层离职的情况下，失去了一名数据中心高管。此次离职发生在新领导下OpenAI基础设施部门进行组织重组之后。
